playbookOutputs: Completed Provincial Regulatory Entity (PRE) Form 1B Operating Licence Application Dossier
Detailed Route Description Annexure, Transport Motivation Letter & PRE Lodgement Guide
playbookCommonFailures: Route description is too vague (PRE requires exact origin, turn-by-turn street/highway names, pick-up points, and destination)
Vehicle seating capacity on RC1 logbook does not match the service category applied for on Form 1B

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) & Certified SA ID Copies (< 3 Months) of Directors
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 and certified director ID copies (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 and certified director ID copies (< 90 days).

informationToProvide.label: Valid SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN Letter
informationToProvide.helpText: Provincial Regulatory Entities (PRE) strictly require an original/valid SARS Tax Clearance PIN letter with Form 1B.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Valid SARS Tax Compliance Status (TCS) PIN letter in the applicant name.

informationToProvide.label: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC1 / Logbook)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Certificate of registration showing vehicle VIN, engine number, and seating capacity.

informationToProvide.label: Valid Roadworthy Certificate (Certificate of Fitness - COF)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Current roadworthy certificate issued by an approved testing station.

informationToProvide.label: Driver's Licence with valid PrDP (Public Road Driver Permit)
informationToProvide.aiHint: Driver licence card showing active PrDP category (Passengers).

informationToProvide.label: Intended Operating Area / Routes
informationToProvide.aiHint: Metro area, radius in km, or specific originating and destination points.

informationToProvide.label: Transport Service Contract / Scholar List / Route Support Letter & Passenger Liability Insurance Confirmation
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your signed charter/staff/scholar transport contract (or taxi association support letter) and proof of Passenger Liability Insurance.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed passenger transport contract, school/parent schedule, or association letter of support alongside Passenger Liability Insurance schedule.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect vehicle and operator documentation
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Logbook, COF, PrDP, and tax clearance verified

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft Form 1B and route specification dossier
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Form 1B populated with vehicle details and route coordinates

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver PRE submission pack to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Lodgement bundle and board payment instructions delivered
